verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details Lowenstein Sandler's U.S.-based venture capital, IP, privacy, and employment practices, but contains no mention of international investors, cross-border flips/redomiciliations, multi-jurisdiction financings, or any foreign offices/capabilities — all seven listed offices are domestic (NY, Palo Alto, Roseland NJ, Salt Lake City, SF, DC, Wilmington DE).
